profile.name: Arpit Sangal
profile.title: Java/Spring Boot Backend Engineer
profile.tagline: Java/Spring Boot Backend Engineer with 3+ years building production REST APIs, microservices, and database-backed enterprise applications.

paragraphs: I'm a Java/Spring Boot Backend Engineer with 3+ years of experience developing and supporting production REST APIs, microservices, and database-backed enterprise applications.

My work spans SQL optimization, caching, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, automated testing, production debugging, and CI/CD workflows across AWS- and GCP-hosted environments.

I contribute across requirements analysis, implementation, deployment, and post-release support, with GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Copilot supporting code review, test scaffolding, refactoring, and documentation.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
points: Develop and maintain Java/Spring Boot APIs for enterprise operational workflows, including request validation, business rules, database integration, Angular-facing API contracts, and production release support.
Improved response times for selected APIs through SQL query profiling, query optimization, backend refactoring, and targeted caching for high-read operations.
Refactored Spring Boot services to improve inter-service communication, error handling, and long-term maintainability.
Implemented asynchronous processing for long-running workflows, separating background operations from synchronous API requests and improving responsiveness.
Implemented authentication and role-based authorization for backend APIs and integrated application services with AWS-hosted infrastructure.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
points: Owned the backend implementation of activity-tracking and reporting modules for an internal work-allocation platform used by 100+ users.
Identified latency bottlenecks and improved core application response times through SQL query optimization and targeted caching.
Investigated recurring production incidents, performed root-cause analysis, and implemented preventive fixes across application and database layers.
Integrated backend workflows with GCP Cloud Storage and Cloud SQL within a Compute Engine-hosted environment and supported associated deployment activities.
Refactored legacy service and data-access logic to improve code reuse, readability, and maintainability.

experiences.title: Associate Software Engineer
points: Developed Spring Boot APIs and implemented JWT-based authentication and authorization for protected application workflows.
Integrated third-party REST APIs and optimized MySQL queries through indexing and query tuning.
Added unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito, increasing measured code coverage to above 80%.
Supported automated build and deployment pipelines using Maven, Git, and Jenkins.
Developed Angular components and integrated them with backend REST APIs.

experiences.title: Associate Software Engineer
points: Developed REST APIs and backend services for a location-based city-exploration application, contributing across API design, implementation, testing, and deployment support.
Implemented asynchronous processing and batch operations to improve backend workflow efficiency and application responsiveness.
Aligned frontend-backend API contracts and integrated Spring Boot services with Angular components.
Participated in code reviews, debugging, and production issue resolution to maintain service reliability and code quality.
Collaborated with business analysts and product teams to translate functional requirements into REST APIs and backend workflow enhancements.
Integrated third-party mapping and location APIs and handled external-service errors within backend workflows.

projects.name: eWAT
projects.description: Enterprise Work Allocation Tool — an internal platform for tracking production/non-production hours and task allocation for 100+ users.
highlights: Designed the MySQL schema and indexing strategy for production and non-production activity tracking across 100+ users, using targeted indexes to avoid full-table scans and support responsive dashboard queries
Implemented scheduled report generation and downloadable activity logs, moving report processing outside synchronous API request flows and reducing repeated database operations

highlights: Developed Spring Boot APIs for badge creation, exchange, ownership, and collection-management workflows
Implemented JWT-based authentication and authorization for protected endpoints
Supported authenticated workflows in the Angular frontend
